mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id, member_name, email, role, status, last_login_at FROM MEMBER
SELECT member_id, login_id, password, member_name, email, role, status, created_at, last_login_at FROM MEMBER WHERE login_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( login_id, password, member_name, email, phone, role, status, created_at, last_login_at ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{memberName}, #{email}, NULLIF(#{phone}, ''), 'MEMBER', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id, password, member_name, email, phone, role, status, created_at, updated_at, last_login_at, social_type, social_user_id FROM MEMBER WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET member_name = #{memberName}, email = #{email}, phone = NULLIF(#{phone}, ''), updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBER SET password = #{newPassword}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBER SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id, member_name, email, phone, role, status, created_at, last_login_at, social_type, social_user_id FROM MEMBER WHERE social_type = #{socialType} AND social_user_id = #{socialUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( member_name, email, role, status, created_at, last_login_at, social_type, social_user_id, connected_at ) VALUES ( #{memberName}, #{email}, 'MEMBER', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW(), #{socialType}, #{socialUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id, member_name, email, status, created_at, social_type FROM MEMBER WHERE member_name = #{memberName} AND email = #{email} AND status != 'WITHDRAWN' LIMIT 1
SELECT member_id, login_id, member_name, email, status, social_type FROM MEMBER WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND member_name = #{memberName} AND email = #{email} AND status != 'WITHDRAWN' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET last_login_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBER SET status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(last_login_at, updated_at, created_at) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
UPDATE MEMBER SET status = 'ACTIVE', last_login_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'INACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_type AS policyType, title AS title, content AS content, is_required AS isRequired FROM POLICY WHERE is_active = 'Y' AND policy_type IN ('TERMS', 'PRIVACY', 'MARKETING') ORDER BY FIELD(policy_type, 'TERMS', 'PRIVACY', 'MARKETING')
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET phone = #{phone}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.POST_TITLE AS postTitle, P.POST_CONTENT AS postContent, P.POST_STATUS AS postStatus, DATE_FORMAT(P.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_ID = P.POST_ID) AS likeCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT C WHERE C.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND C.COMMENT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS commentCnt, (SELECT I.IMAGE_URL FROM COMMUNITY_IMAGE I WHERE I.COMMUNITY_POST_ID = P.POST_ID ORDER BY I.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl FROM COMMUNITY_POST P WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.POST_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'HIDDEN') ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.POST_ID DESC

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, C.POST_ID AS postId, C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID AS parentCommentId, C.COMMENT_CONTENT AS commentContent, C.COMMENT_STATUS AS commentStatus, DATE_FORMAT(C.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, P.POST_CONTENT AS postContent, P.POST_STATUS AS postStatus FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT C LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST P ON P.POST_ID = C.POST_ID WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND C.COMMENT_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'HIDDEN') ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC, C.COMMENT_ID DESC
